name: Odin
label: Idle
description: Dignified combat idle breathing loop in place, strict side-scroller profile facing RIGHT. Subtle chest rise and fall, gentle wind flutter along the tattered dark cloak hem and beard, the perched black raven shifts its head and feathers subtly on his shoulder, tall wooden spear and boots planted solidly on the exact same floor baseline. Return cleanly to the initial standing pose. Preserve crisp dark hermetic pixel art, same scale and palette. Static camera, transparent background.
